shigureni.name: shigureni free illust
shigureni.summary: Free for use in apps and websites. Permitted editing includes resizing, cropping, recolouring, flipping, adding text, simple compositing and animation — a speech bubble beside the cat and the pop-up motion are both within that. Creating another illustration from theirs by any means, including hand-drawing and tracing, is forbidden, as is any generative-AI use: the cat is only ever this file, cropped and scaled, and the small cat on inline tips is a crop of it, never a redraw.
shigureni.commercialUse: With this file the app uses TEN shigureni illustrations (nine seats and this mascot), above the 5 free for commercial use. Poker Master is a free site with no revenue, so the ceiling does not apply as things stand; if that changes, five additional licences are needed. See ../avatars/README.md.
